content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Dayton

steps_items.heading: 1. Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Verify you meet these education and experience thresholds before enrolling. Dayton's aerospace, healthcare, and manufacturing sectors actively employ PMP-certified professionals.

steps_items.heading: 2. Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our sessions are interactive and led by active certified practitioners. You'll learn the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application—all on a schedule that fits your Dayton-area work and life.

steps_items.heading: 3. Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your official PMP application to PMI, including proof of your education and project-management experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at that time. Our team can guide you through the application process to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: 4. Prepare and Test
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A support—to build confidence. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE. Our graduates report that targeted review and hands-on practice significantly strengthen exam readiness.

steps_items.heading: 5. Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification remains valid for three years. During this cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or publishing. Renew before expiration to keep your credential active and stay competitive in Dayton's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
